Class RatchetPlanner

java.lang.Object
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.RatchetPlanner
public final class RatchetPlanner extends Object
Computes the downward-only tightening of a ledger against the latest session's observed counts.

The asymmetry is deliberate: counts only move down mechanically (an accepted finding class shrank — tighten the baseline, keeping the entry at 0 as a documented tripwire rather than deleting the acceptance record). Accepting new findings or grown counts is always a human edit.

    • plan

      public static RatchetPlanner.Plan plan(Ledger ledger, Map<String,Long> observed)
      Plans the tightening of a ledger against observed counts.
      Parameters:
      ledger - the current ledger
      observed - per-key observed counts from the latest session's sidecar; keys absent from the map observed nothing
      Returns:
      the plan; entries never loosen, and entries at or below their observation are untouched
